title: Problem Statement and Motivation
subtitle: Challenges in Enterprise and Academic Knowledge Retrieval
speaker: Shaurya Dixit
bullets: Hallucination Risk: Foundation LLMs fabricate convincing but false facts on domain-specific corpora.
Knowledge Cutoff: Pre-trained models cannot access newly released research papers or internal institution documents.
Keyword Search Inadequacy: Traditional keyword engines miss semantic and conceptual context in research literature.
Academic Data Grounding: Evaluating RAG on Kaggle academic research paper datasets requires deterministic verification.

title: Proposed Solution: DocuQuery AI
subtitle: Deterministic Retrieval-Augmented Generation Architecture
speaker: Shaurya Dixit
bullets: Java Spring Boot 3 Backend: Type-safe, high-throughput microservice handling retrieval, chunking, and streaming.
Neon PostgreSQL with pgvector: Unified relational and vector database with sub-100ms HNSW cosine lookups.
Electron + React 18 Desktop Shell: Cross-platform desktop interface with native IPC and drag-and-drop ingestion.
Automated RAG Triad Evaluation: Real-time scoring of Context Relevance, Faithfulness, and Answer Relevance.

title: End-to-End System Architecture
subtitle: Data Flow: Client -> Spring Boot -> Neon pgvector -> LLM
speaker: Shaurya Dixit
bullets: Step 1: User submits query via Electron Desktop UI or Web interface (/api/rag/chat).
Step 2: Spring Security validates JWT token and Bucket4j enforces rate limits.
Step 3: Query is converted to 1536-dimensional dense embedding vector.
Step 4: Neon PostgreSQL executes HNSW cosine distance search returning Top-4 chunks in under 94ms.
Step 5: Spring AI prompt engine injects context chunks with anti-hallucination constraints.
Step 6: LLM streams response token-by-token over Server-Sent Events (SSE) with verifiable citations.

title: Module 1: Core RAG Engine & LLM Orchestration
subtitle: Owner: Shaurya Dixit (Team Leader) | Branch: feature/member1-rag-engine
speaker: Shaurya Dixit (Lead)
bullets: Spring AI RAG Orchestration Service: Coordinates embedding generation and vector lookup.
Prompt Template Guardrails: Injects explicit boundaries ('Answer only from context, else state unknown').
Dynamic Token Budgeting: Allocates context window tokens to ensure zero truncation.
Server-Sent Events (SSE) Controller: Real-time token streaming to Electron frontend.
Dynamic Citation Linker: Appends verifiable chunk IDs and page numbers directly to responses.

title: Module 2: Document Ingestion, Parsing & Chunking
subtitle: Owner: Yashvardhan Singh Chauhan | Branch: feature/member2-doc-ingestion
speaker: Yashvardhan Singh Chauhan
bullets: Kaggle Dataset Curation: Ingestion of academic research papers, syllabi, and technical reports (PDF, DOCX, TXT).
Multi-Format Extraction: Apache Tika 2.9 and PDFBox 3 parse documents up to 25MB.
Recursive Sliding-Window Chunker: 500-token window with 50-token overlap.
Sentence Boundary Preservation: Java BreakIterator prevents breaking sentences across chunk boundaries.
Asynchronous Task Queue: Spring @Async ThreadPoolTaskExecutor prevents UI blocking.

title: Module 3: Neon PostgreSQL Vector Store & Security
subtitle: Owner: Vaibhav Tank | Branch: feature/member3-database-security
speaker: Vaibhav Tank
bullets: Serverless PostgreSQL: Neon cloud instance configured with PgBouncer connection pooling.
pgvector HNSW Indexing: vector(1536) columns with vector_cosine_ops (m=16, ef_construction=64).
Spring Security 6: Stateless SessionCreationPolicy with HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens.
Role-Based Access Control: Granular permissions for ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_RESEARCHER, and ROLE_STUDENT.
API Rate Limiting: Bucket4j token bucket algorithm enforcing max 30 requests/minute per IP.

title: Module 4: React UI & Electron Desktop Integration
subtitle: Owner: Rajveer Singh Ranawat | Branch: feature/member4-ui-electron
speaker: Rajveer Singh Ranawat
bullets: Electron 30 Desktop Frame: Secure contextIsolation and sandboxed preload IPC bridge.
React 18 + TypeScript SPA: Tailwind CSS dark-mode styling with Lucide icons.
Streaming Markdown Chat: Real-time token consumption with code syntax highlighting and KaTeX math.
Interactive Citation Inspector: Clickable badges opening exact source excerpts and similarity scores.
Document Workspace: Drag-and-drop upload zone with real-time indexing status progress bars.

title: Module 5: RAG Triad Evaluation & Admin Telemetry
subtitle: Owner: Yashpal Singh Bhati | Branch: feature/member5-analytics-evaluation
speaker: Yashpal Singh Bhati
bullets: RAG Triad Metrics: Context Relevance, Groundedness (Faithfulness), and Answer Relevance.
Admin Telemetry Dashboard: Recharts visualization of query volume, latency histograms, and index size.
Automated Testing Suite: JUnit 5 and Mockito test cases achieving 84.6% branch coverage.
Golden Dataset Benchmark: 50 ground-truth academic Q&A pairs evaluated continuously against Kaggle dataset.
Hallucination Auditing: Tracks factual consistency and logs low-confidence queries.

title: Experimental Results & RAG Triad Scores
subtitle: Quantitative Evaluation on 50 Technical Q&A Benchmark Pairs
speaker: Yashpal Singh Bhati
bullets: Context Relevance: 88.6% (Target > 80%) - Retrieved chunks strictly pertinent to user query.
Faithfulness / Groundedness: 92.4% (Target > 85%) - Claims strictly entailed by retrieved context.
Answer Relevance: 90.1% (Target > 85%) - Semantic alignment with user intent.
Hallucination Rate: 3.2% - Well below industry benchmark of 15-20%.
Average Vector Retrieval Latency: 94 ms - Sub-100ms cosine similarity lookup in Neon pgvector.

title: Performance Benchmarking & Concurrency (JMeter)
subtitle: Stress Analysis Under 50 Concurrent Virtual Users
speaker: Vaibhav Tank
bullets: Throughput: 42.4 requests/second sustained over 10-minute continuous execution.
First-Token Latency (p99): 850 ms over local network streaming.
HTTP Error Rate: 0.0% (Zero connection drops under PgBouncer connection pooling).
Memory Stability: Spring Boot JVM heap stabilized below 480MB under continuous Garbage Collection.
Desktop Client RAM: Electron client consumes under 150MB RAM in idle state.

title: Desktop Application User Experience
subtitle: Walkthrough of Core Operational Screens
speaker: Rajveer Singh Ranawat
bullets: 1. Real-Time Chat Canvas: Fast token streaming, Markdown formatting, code copy buttons.
2. Interactive Citation Badges: Displays document name, page number, and similarity score.
3. Source Excerpt Modal: Opens instant verbatim passage from source PDF for immediate verification.
4. Document Management: Drag-and-drop multi-file upload with live parsing progress.
5. Admin Telemetry Panel: Live display of query counts, average latencies, and Triad scores.
